content: Over sixty student pullers took to the table during the Greater Accra Armwrestling Championship held at the University of Ghana Sports Complex.
Technical coaches praised the rapid adoption of international tournament grip techniques, hook transitions, and strap management among emerging youth athletes.
The top three finishers in each weight division will earn direct entry into the 2027 National Golden Arms selection trials.

articles.title: Accra Basketball League: Braves Edge Reformers in Thrilling Overtime Derby
articles.author: Kofi Boateng · Basketball Desk
articles.excerpt: A buzzer-beating floater in extra time sealed an 84-82 victory for Braves of Customs against Prisons Reformers at the Cantonments Basketball Court.
content: The Accra Basketball League (ABL) Men's Division 1 provided pure drama on Friday night as defending champions Braves of Customs overcame a 14-point fourth-quarter deficit to defeat fierce rivals Prisons Reformers.
Guard Nana Kwame paced the Braves with 26 points and 8 assists, sinking the decisive floating jumper off the glass with just 1.8 seconds remaining in overtime.
The result tightens the standings at the summit of the ABL table, with the playoff picture coming into sharp focus heading into the final month of the regular season.

articles.title: Sprite Ball Championship: High School Powerhouses Prepare for Regional Qualifiers
articles.author: Selorm Agyemang · High School Sports
articles.excerpt: Western and Eastern region giants Mfantsipim, Prempeh College, and Keta Business College announce their rosters for the prestigious Sprite Ball Championship.
content: Ghana's most renowned high school basketball tournament, Sprite Ball, has announced its qualification schedule spanning six regional centers.
Defending boys' division champions Mfantsipim School will face stiff competition from Kumasi's Prempeh College, while Sacred Heart Senior High looks to repeat in the girls' division.
The tournament continues to serve as the single most critical scout recruiting platform for collegiate scholarships and national junior team call-ups.

articles.title: Sapholda Hockey League: Ex-Chequers and GRA Ladies Set for Title Clash
articles.author: The Sports Digest Sports Desk
articles.excerpt: All eyes turn to the Theodosia Okoh National Hockey Stadium in Accra this weekend as the premier hockey clubs in Ghana face off for the league title.
content: The Greater Accra Hockey Association has confirmed the schedule for this weekend's pivotal Sapholda Hockey League fixtures at the National Hockey Stadium.

In the men's division, table-toppers Ex-Chequers take on Trustees in a match that will determine the destination of the trophy. In the women's division, GRA Ladies look to preserve their unblemished record against Reformers Ladies.
Both clubs are also using the competition to finalize roster combinations ahead of the African Hockey Club Championship.

articles.title: National Beach Volleyball Camp Established in Ada Ahead of Continental Tour
articles.author: Selorm Agyemang · Volleyball Desk
articles.excerpt: Ghana Volleyball Association (GVA) convenes a high-intensity sand training camp on the Ada coastline to prepare men's and women's pairs for CAVB qualifiers.
content: The Ghana Volleyball Association has launched a dedicated two-week training camp in Ada for eight national beach volleyball duos.
The training regimen focuses on wind adaptation, quick lateral transitions on soft sand, and specialized jump-float service reception.
The head coach noted that recent performances on the West African circuit demonstrate Ghana has the physical presence and agility to compete with the continent's top-seeded pairs.

articles.title: National Table Tennis Championship: Junior Phenoms Impress in Trust Sports Emporium Showcase
articles.author: Nii Ayitey Hammond · Olympic Sports
articles.excerpt: Over 120 competitors from across ten regions converged on the Trust Sports Emporium in Accra for the 2026 National Table Tennis Top 16 Championship.
content: The Ghana Table Tennis Association (GTTA) concluded its premier domestic competition over the weekend, spotlighting rapid developmental strides among teenage contenders.

Fourteen-year-old sensation Blessing Darko swept the girls' under-18 category with crisp forehand loops and aggressive backhand counter-blocks, earning an automatic invitation to the senior national trials.
GTTA leadership praised corporate partners for supporting equipment upgrades and regional grassroots development across public schools.
